quote: To evaluate the performance of VLMs, we adopt two evaluation methods: "Naive Matching" and "LLM-Judged" evaluation.

The Naive Matching method evaluates responses based on exact string matching with the ground-truth answers, while the LLM-Judged evaluation method uses Prompted LLMs (gpt-4o, Qwen3-8B) to compare ground truth and candidate answers directly.
